simple.meaning: מִקְשָׁה (miqshâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “literally a cucumbered field, i.e. a cucumber patch.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H4750. miqshah I. מִקְשָׁה noun feminine place, field, of cucumbers , Isa 1:8 ; so Jer 10:5 Gf Gie and others (compare Baruch Jeremiah 6:70).
